summary: Phase 1 production-foundation regression + new-feature validation complete. All 54 backend pytest cases pass (38 legacy regression + 16 new phase1 foundation) in ~47s. All new /api/v1 auth gates return the new {error:{code,message}} envelope (UNAUTHENTICATED on /api/v1/creator-intent and /api/v1/sync/youtube without cookie; NOT_CONFIGURED on /api/auth/google/login). Payload guard returns 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE at >262144 bytes. Rate limit returns 429 RATE_LIMITED with retry_after meta after 20 idea-lab POSTs/hour. Demo bootstrap /api/v1/me returns is_demo=true, is_authenticated=false, creator.id=alex-morgan, dna_status=not_computed. Legacy demo shapes preserved: /api/creators/alex-morgan/opportunities returns bare list of 5 with scores; /api/trends returns bare list of 8; /api/opportunities/opp-1 returns score=92 + 4 why_bullets (real Claude, cached-versioned). Frontend regression: /app (Feed 5 cards), /app/dna (Alex Morgan dashboard), /onboarding (Explore Demo btn), /app/studio (Assistant + Weekly), /app/shortlist, /app/idea/opp-1 (real Claude concept/titles/hooks/structure rendered), /app/trends — all load cleanly; demo-badge (data-testid) visible bottom-left on every route. Zero regressions.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:94,100 uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). FastAPI recommends lifespan handlers. Non-blocking but flagged for future cleanup (also seen in iterations 3-4 warnings).

core/rate_limit.py in-memory bucket resets on backend restart; acceptable for single-instance MVP but must move to Redis before horizontal scale-out. Rate-limit key is `ideas-{user.user_id}` — in demo mode all traffic collapses onto user_id='demo-user' so one abusive tab can lock the whole demo for an hour. Consider keying by (user_id, IP) or per-IP for demo.

server.py collab-proposal (line ~292) does not validate that from_creator_id in body matches the resolved caller identity. In demo it does not matter, but in production a caller could pretend to be another creator when creating a proposal. test_caller_cannot_override_identity_via_shortlist only asserts shortlist-side; collab-proposal owner should be re-derived from CurrentUser, not accepted from body.

Backend tests test_iteration2/3/backend_test require REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env at import time. Not a bug per se, but running `pytest tests/` without exporting the frontend env fails collection. Consider a conftest.py that loads /app/frontend/.env, or reading it inside a fixture.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of priority routes (Feed / DNA / Onboarding / Studio / Shortlist / Idea Lab / Trends) + demo-badge visible on all

test_credentials: None. /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty (only header). Google OAuth intentionally unconfigured per task brief; auth boundary tests all covered on the unauthenticated 401/400 path.
seed_data_creation: Regression tests reuse existing per-run X-Client-Id namespaces (TEST_iter* prefixes). Phase1 pytest uses per-run ephemeral DBs (test_phase1_<uuid>) that are auto-dropped. Live rate-limit bucket for `ideas-demo-user` was tripped during the 429 verification then cleared by `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` so subsequent Idea Lab traffic is unaffected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://opportunity-feed-6.preview.emergentagent.com. To run full pytest: `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://opportunity-feed-6.preview.emergentagent.com && cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v`. Phase1 suite (test_phase1_foundation.py) is pure-unit with ephemeral Mongo DBs (~2s), safe to run anytime. Regression suite hits real Claude (~45s, real cost). Rate limit is IN-MEMORY per user_id — a supervisor restart clears it. In demo mode user_id collapses to 'demo-user' so one heavy test run can 429 later runs; restart backend if you see unexpected 429s during frontend smoke. New error envelope everywhere: {error:{code,message[,meta]}}. Frontend routes to smoke: /app, /app/dna, /onboarding, /app/studio (both tabs), /app/shortlist, /app/idea/opp-1, /app/trends, /app/opportunity/opp-1. demo-badge selector: [data-testid='demo-badge'].
